name: dm-social-contributions
description: Dominica Social Security contribution calculations and remittance reference for 2026. Covers employee and employer rates with and without redundancy coverage, the monthly earnings ceiling, capped examples, self-employed contributions and payment dates. Use for Dominica DSS, employer insurance contributions, redundancy contribution classification or self-employed social security. The dated 2026 notice and contribution schedule take precedence over older numerical examples in the FAQ. Coverage status, earnings classification and reciprocal-agreement exemptions need individual verification. Benefit calculations, voluntary contribution eligibility and partial-period payroll mechanics remain outside this draft. Monetary examples use Eastern Caribbean dollars.
